metadata.title: October 21, 2005 - Making It
metadata.author: By Manny Nosowsky / Edited by Mike Shenk

entries.clue: It has eyes on its skin
Cleaning up like the Pillsbury Doughboy?
Highly placed at a fire sale?
Nymph changed to a laurel tree
Mention in an acceptance speech, maybe
Prosperous like Mona Lisa while modeling?
Hardly the pick of the litter
